The description can be bland, such as "scheduled parameter optimisation batch", so do not judge it by its wording. A step at the change time. ... What stays normal. ...

[RB-RAN-UPGRADE-REGRESSION#02] RAN software upgrade regression > Signature in the data: A software upgrade change on a site or group of sites, executed at night. A short availability dip during the restart is expected, typically one or two steps. Persistent quality loss after the restart. Elevated `drop_rate_pct`, lower `rrc_success_pct`, and sometimes a lower volume that does not recover on the following days. ... Version-specific. ... Repeated restarts. ...
[RB-BAD-CHANGE#03] Bad change and configuration regression > Differential diagnosis: Versus the many harmless changes ... Almost all have no effect. ... A bad change leaves PRB normal or lower, latency flat, and drops RRC success. ... DNS trouble is nationwide, raises latency and leaves RRC success alone. A bad change is confined to the changed subtree, lowers RRC success and leaves latency flat. ... A fiber cut or power failure sets availability to 0. ...

result.markdown:
# RRC success rate drop in Grand Tunis due to bad parameter tuning

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** bad_change at `S-TUN-004`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct evidence of parameter tuning changes matching KPI drops, confirmed by runbooks, active alarms, and complete recovery upon rollback.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-12 09:30 to 2026-09-12 20:00
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-12 09:42
- **Affected:** S-TUN-004, S-TUN-005, S-TUN-016

## Summary

Scheduled parameter optimisation batch RT-2.5 was applied to sites S-TUN-004, S-TUN-005, and S-TUN-016, causing RRC success rate drops until rolled back.

RRC success rate fell and drop rate spiked across three sites in Grand Tunis for 10.5 hours.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-12 09:30: Anomalies detected with traffic and RRC success rate drop on 3 sites. [ALR-0011]
- 2026-09-12 09:42: Parameter optimisation batch RT-2.5 applied to S-TUN-004, S-TUN-005, and S-TUN-016. [CHG-2026-0028, CHG-2026-0029, CHG-2026-0030]
- 2026-09-12 10:12: Minor RRC failure rate alarm raised on S-TUN-004. [ALM-000200]
- 2026-09-12 10:26: Minor RRC failure rate alarm raised on S-TUN-016. [ALM-000202]
- 2026-09-12 19:53: Alarm on S-TUN-004 cleared following rollback. [ALM-000200]
- 2026-09-12 20:00: Alarm on S-TUN-016 cleared and alert ALR-0011 ended. [ALM-000202, ALR-0011]

## Evidence

- Traffic and RRC success drop with drop rate spike occurred on S-TUN-004, S-TUN-005, and S-TUN-016. [ALR-0011]
- Parameter optimization batch RT-2.5 was executed on S-TUN-004, S-TUN-005, and S-TUN-016 at 2026-09-12 09:42. [CHG-2026-0028, CHG-2026-0029, CHG-2026-0030]
- No maintenance window was scheduled on the affected sites and their parents between 2026-09-12 08:00 and 13:00. [T6]
- No external events were recorded for region TUN between 2026-09-12 08:00 and 13:00. [T8]
- Configuration regressions lead to RRC success drops confined to the changed subtree. [RB-BAD-CHANGE#02]

## Hypotheses

1. **bad_change** at S-TUN-004: confirmed. Parameter tuning changes matched the KPI degradation onset and sites recovered entirely after rollback. [CHG-2026-0028, CHG-2026-0029, CHG-2026-0030, ALR-0011]
2. **transport_degradation** at LNK-TUN-02-B: rejected. No critical or major transport alarms were present, and changes directly account for the site-level impact. [T2, CHG-2026-0028]

## Ruled out

- T6: No maintenance windows were scheduled during the incident timeline.
- T8: No external events or holidays took place in region TUN during the incident window.
- T2: Only minor alarms were observed, with no critical or major alarms indicating transport or hardware failure.

## Recommended actions

- Review parameter optimization batch RT-2.5 configurations before future deployments.
- Verify pre-change validation steps for RRC success rate parameters on urban and rural sites.

truth.notes: trap=bad_change_loud_coincidence; A scheduled parameter optimisation batch pushed to the 3 sites of LNK-TUN-02-B regressed RRC success and drop rate until it was rolled back. Root cause node is the first site of the pushed group. Trap: a major alarm on LNK-TUN-02-B, the parent of the pushed sites, flaps around the onset and clears by itself, and the change record looks innocent. Settled by: (1) the alarm clears within minutes while the KPI regression goes on for hours, and availability stays at 100 %; (2) the regression starts at the change time on exactly the pushed sites and ends at the rollback; (3) the sites of the sibling links are normal.
